decision: carried spike follow-ups into P12 and P13 briefs: messy-EPUB errors, server recheck of spine_lengths, per-chapter length check

why: worker said PASS; my first rerun failed the storage test, then 3 full runs passed; the worker proved the gate tests can fail by loosening policies

decision: left the storage-test flake open instead of adding a retry

decision: P12 must compute sha256 and spine_lengths on the server and stop clients inserting book rows directly
